name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Income support scheme for eligible farmer families.
benefits: Financial assistance according to current PM-KISAN guidelines.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify land records, beneficiary-family criteria and exclusions against current official guidelines.

name: Kisan Credit Card
description: Credit facility for eligible farmers and other eligible agricultural borrowers.
benefits: Agricultural credit subject to lending rules and current scheme guidelines.

eligibility.verification_note: Confirm applicant category, eligible activities, bank requirements and applicable interest concessions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana
description: Voluntary contributory pension scheme for eligible small and marginal farmers.
benefits: Pension benefits subject to enrolment and applicable scheme conditions.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify farmer category, entry age, landholding limits, exclusions and contribution requirements.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
description: Maharashtra government direct-benefit scheme for eligible women.
benefits: Financial assistance under the current state guidelines.

eligibility.verification_note: Also verify Maharashtra residence, marital-status conditions, family exclusions and current application rules.

name: Mahila Swarnima Yojana
description: Financial assistance scheme for eligible women from notified backward classes.
benefits: Concessional financial assistance subject to the implementing agency's rules.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify notified community, family-income ceiling, loan purpose and current NBCFDC lending conditions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Urban
description: Housing assistance under applicable PMAY-Urban scheme components.
benefits: Housing support subject to the applicable component and eligibility rules.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify the current PMAY-U component, household income, existing house ownership and other exclusions.

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: Support for eligible traditional artisans and craftspeople.
benefits: Training, toolkit incentives and credit-related support subject to scheme rules.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify the official notified trade list, self-employment conditions, family restrictions and previous-loan conditions.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
description: Credit support scheme for eligible street vendors.
benefits: Working-capital loan facilities and applicable incentives under current rules.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify vendor identification, certificate or survey status, lending conditions and current scheme extensions.

name: PM-KUSUM
description: Support for eligible solar energy installations in the agricultural sector.
benefits: Assistance under applicable components and state implementation rules.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify the relevant component, state availability, beneficiary category, project requirements and current application window.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme
description: Financial assistance scheme implemented through applicable social assistance arrangements.
benefits: Assistance subject to current scheme rules and state implementation.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify household circumstances, qualifying death conditions, income or poverty criteria and the applicable state process.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
description: Rural household employment guarantee implemented by eligible local authorities.
benefits: Wage employment according to the Act and applicable rules.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify rural household registration, adult household members willing to perform unskilled manual work and local job-card requirements.

name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
description: Rural road connectivity programme implemented through government agencies.
benefits: Rural infrastructure development; generally not an individual cash-benefit scheme.

eligibility.verification_note: This is primarily an infrastructure programme. Do not present it as a direct individual cash benefit.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission
description: Programme focused on rural household tap-water supply.
benefits: Rural drinking-water infrastructure and service provision.

eligibility.verification_note: This is a public service programme, not necessarily an individual cash transfer. Verify local coverage through the relevant authority.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission Grameen
description: Rural sanitation and cleanliness programme.
benefits: Sanitation support under applicable programme guidelines.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify the relevant component, household eligibility and current state implementation conditions.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises
description: Support for eligible micro food-processing enterprises.
benefits: Credit-linked and other support under the applicable scheme guidelines.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify enterprise type, applicant category, project details, financial conditions and whether applications are currently accepted.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
description: Credit-linked assistance programme for eligible micro-enterprise projects.
benefits: Margin-money subsidy subject to scheme and bank conditions.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify age, project cost, education conditions where applicable, eligible activities and current KVIC guidelines.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
description: Loans through eligible lending institutions for qualifying micro enterprises.
benefits: Business credit according to lender appraisal and applicable loan categories.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify business activity, lender requirements, repayment capacity and the current applicable loan category.

name: Stand-Up India
description: Bank-loan programme designed to support eligible women and SC/ST entrepreneurs.
benefits: Bank credit subject to applicable programme rules and current availability.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify applicant category, ownership or control of the enterprise, greenfield project requirements and current availability.

name: Startup India
description: Government initiative supporting eligible startups through recognition and associated programmes.
benefits: Recognition and access to applicable support programmes, subject to separate criteria.

eligibility.verification_note: Startup recognition is not automatic funding. Verify entity type, incorporation date and current DPIIT recognition criteria.

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises
description: Credit guarantee framework for eligible loans to micro and small enterprises.
benefits: Credit guarantee coverage for eligible lending arrangements; not a direct cash grant to applicants.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify enterprise classification, lender participation, loan eligibility and current guarantee rules.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
description: Skill training and certification initiative under applicable programme guidelines.
benefits: Training and assessment support for eligible courses and batches.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify active batches, age conditions, course availability and training-centre requirements.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
description: Rural youth skill-development and placement-linked programme.
benefits: Training and placement-related support under current programme rules.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify age, rural-poor eligibility criteria, state implementation and active training providers.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
description: Health coverage for eligible households under applicable scheme criteria.
benefits: Cashless treatment coverage under approved packages and scheme rules.

eligibility.verification_note: Eligibility depends on official beneficiary records and applicable state arrangements; verify through the official beneficiary system.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description: LPG connection scheme for eligible households under current rules.
benefits: LPG connection support subject to eligibility and applicable assistance guidelines.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify adult-woman applicant requirement, household eligibility, existing LPG connection and current documentation rules.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana
description: Financial inclusion initiative to facilitate access to basic banking services.
benefits: Basic bank-account services and applicable benefits under current rules.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify bank-account requirements and eligibility for any linked insurance or overdraft benefit separately.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
description: Residential rooftop solar programme.
benefits: Central financial assistance under applicable rooftop-solar guidelines.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify residential connection, eligible system capacity, vendor conditions and current subsidy terms.

name: National Scholarship Portal
description: Online platform for participating government scholarship schemes.
benefits: Scholarship assistance as specified by the individual scholarship.

eligibility.verification_note: This portal hosts multiple scholarships. Verify the specific scholarship, education level, marks, income and category requirements.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance scheme subject to notified crops and applicable state-season rules.
benefits: Insurance protection as provided by the current scheme and policy terms.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify notified crops, area, season, enrolment dates and current farmer eligibility.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana Gramin
description: Rural housing programme for households selected under applicable eligibility rules.
benefits: Housing assistance as prescribed by current programme guidelines.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify official household selection, deprivation criteria, exclusions and current beneficiary lists.

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
description: Maharashtra farmer-support scheme linked to applicable state rules.
benefits: Financial assistance according to the current state scheme guidelines.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify PM-KISAN beneficiary requirements, state-specific conditions and current government resolutions.

name: PMKSY Per Drop More Crop Micro-Irrigation
description: Micro-irrigation support available through applicable Maharashtra agriculture schemes.
benefits: Assistance subject to component, applicant eligibility and current state guidelines.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify farmer registration, land and crop requirements, approved equipment, subsidy ceilings and current application window.

name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana
description: Agriculture support scheme for eligible SC farmers under Maharashtra guidelines.
benefits: Agricultural inputs or infrastructure assistance according to approved scheme components.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify category certificate, landholding requirements, income conditions and current agriculture-department rules.

name: Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana
description: Agriculture support scheme for eligible tribal farmers under Maharashtra guidelines.
benefits: Agricultural assistance according to the applicable scheme components.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify tribal-category requirements, land records, income conditions and the applicable Tribal Sub-Plan component.

name: Bhausaheb Fundkar Phalbaag Lagvad Yojana
description: Maharashtra scheme supporting eligible orchard plantation activities.
benefits: Assistance for eligible horticulture activities under current scheme rules.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify eligible fruit crops, acreage, farmer category, maintenance requirements and current application conditions.

name: Mukhyamantri Vayoshree Yojana
description: Maharashtra assistance scheme for eligible senior citizens.
benefits: Assistance subject to current state government rules.

eligibility.verification_note: Verify the current age threshold, income criteria, residence, eligible assistive items and application conditions.
